name: Needle
subtitle: Spotify tweak by Renzo
description: Needle adds QR share, playlist cloner, queue long-press, Regram-style Settings, 30 themes, Car mode, Turntable, Album wall, Rating, Forgotten favorites, lockscreen art enlargement and more to Spotify on iOS.

apps.name: Spotify (Needle, OG bundle)
apps.subtitle: Lockscreen tap works
apps.versionDescription: v2.31 - keeps the original com.spotify.client bundle so iOS lockscreen Now Playing tap opens Spotify. Install over the original Spotify. Updates in place as long as you keep installing the og build.
apps.localizedDescription: Spotify with Needle tweak. Keeps com.spotify.client bundle so iOS treats it like the real Spotify for lockscreen Now Playing tap and other system integrations.
